Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team at AstroHealth is excited to run a short evaluation of Redwood for our patient-data summarization workflow. Procurement asked me to put together a high-level MAP so they can track milestones and align on cost before we kick off.

Key asks from our side:
- A 4-week evaluation window with a light production pilot for up to 100k tokens/day during week 4.
- Clear checkpoints at: 1) model parity on our eval prompts, 2) latency SLAs during pilot, 3) security evidence (SOC2 questions).
- Pricing that covers an eval discount and clear ramp pricing if we convert.

Can you share a draft MAP + pricing that includes commit tiers and any early-commit incentives? Procurement prefers a short document they can attach to the SOW.

I've attached our procurement questionnaire for reference (procurement@astrohealth.com copied).

Thanks,

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass MAP + pricing workbook for AstroHealth. High level:

Summary (draft):
- Eval period: 4 weeks (proposed start: 2026-10-25).
- Eval credit: $7,500 of hosted credits + 50% off per-token for eval traffic during weeks 1–3, capped at 300k tokens.
- Pilot ramp: week 4 allowed up to 100k tokens/day; if you convert to a 12-month commit within 30 days of the pilot, we apply a 10% onboarding credit and a tiered committed rate.
- Commit tiers (monthly committed spend):
  * Tier A: $30k+/mo — 12% discount vs public list
  * Tier B: $75k+/mo — 18% discount + reserved capacity option
  * Tier C: $150k+/mo — 25% discount + enhanced SLA
- MAP checkpoints:
  1) Week 1-2: evaluation QA (pass/fail on prompt set accuracy)
  2) Week 3: perf & latency check (SLO: p95 < 350ms on representative traffic)
  3) Week 4: pilot signoff and conversion decision (PO + signing)

I've attached: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with Milestone checklist) and price-sheet-v4.xlsx (detailed rates).

Next steps:
- I'll loop in pricing for confirmation (Ben and Marissa cc'd).
- If that looks good we can lock the start date for 10/25 and circulate a short SOW + DocuSign link.

Logan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Quick thoughts after review:
- Eval credit: $7.5k looks fine. Keep the eval per-token 50% off but cap to reduce abuse — keep the 300k tokens cap.
- Latency SLO: can't promise p95 < 350ms across arbitrary peak traffic for hosted—rephrase to "target p95 < 350ms for pilot traffic profile; SLA for dedicated/reserved capacity only." We can offer an SLA add-on at Tier B+.
- Early-commit incentive: 10% onboarding credit ok, but make it conditional: signed 12-month commit + minimum $30k/mo within 30 days of pilot. Add a 6-week ramp clause to reach committed utilization or credits prorated.
- Discounts: tighten language on Tier C enhanced SLA to specify 99.9% availability and 24x7 priority support.

I'll mark up price-sheet-v4 and push back minor wording in the MAP. Also suggest we add a procurement-required evidence bundle (SOC2, security whitepaper) to the MAP as an attachment for procurement sign-off.

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
